statement: The outstanding open questions that follow immediately √ from this work are: Is there any randomized algorithm with unfairness o( d) on the star with d leaves? Does Randomized Global Greedy have o(n) unfairness on the star or on the line? At this point we have no non-trivial upper bound on the star. The best algorithm we √ know is Randomized Local Greedy, which achieves n unfairness.
